VERDICT goal: The node goal is that a request which never launched reports no elapsed budget time and no overrun; reckon/crew/recovery_stream.py:328 _budget_timing now starts elapsed at attempt_started_at or launched_at and hands a pointer in WAITING_REQUEST_PHASES with no launch stamp to _parked_budget_timing (recovery_stream.py:286), which returns elapsed_seconds None, budget_overrun false and waiting_seconds measured from creation time.
VERDICT done_when: The plan's done-when asks that an awaiting-upstream pointer a week old reports budget_overrun false with waiting_seconds recorded, that a run launched four hours ago on a three-hour budget still reports the overrun, and that a negative control restoring the created_at fallback reddens the first case; gate-head.log records 6 passed EXIT=0, repro-base.log records the same 6 failing at the base revision 3d0ed7f1 EXIT=1, and negative-control.log records FFFF.. (4 failed, 2 passed) EXIT=1 under the declared mutation.
